notes: Cross-verse consistency: the chapter fuses a preposition with the word whose English carries its relation everywhere else (לִפְנֵי -> *before* in vv. 7, 8, 12, 13; לְעֻמַּת -> *hard by* in v. 9), but split לַיהוָה -> *is Jehovah’s* into a copula-bearing preposition and a separate name. No English word is spent on that לְ alone: its possessive relation is written inside the genitive *Jehovah’s*, and *is* is the copula rule 20 hands to the whole predicate, which rule 30 expressly says does not defeat the one-rendering condition (לִפְנֵי -> *was before*). The corpus fuses לְ + the divine name rendered by an English genitive in six units across five chapters and splits none. s016 and s017 now share one aligned unit; all other units are unchanged.
